subject: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>; Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Alex / Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started:

Summary from the call
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference latency and cost profiles for Acme's customer-facing summarization flow (avg seq len ~512 tokens).
- Success criteria (draft) attached: latency < 250ms P95, cost < $0.008/token equivalent, no >3% regression vs baseline on quality evals. See attached spreadsheet (ACME-POC-success-criteria.xlsx).

What I need from you to provision access this week
1) Primary POC owner(s) and evaluation stakeholders (product/infra/infosec). Please list names + emails.
2) For provisioning: list of public IP ranges your infra team will use for API calls (we'll add to allowlist) OR confirm you prefer SSO-only access.
3) SSO: domain(s) to invite (Okta / Azure AD). If you want SSO only, please confirm SSO admin who can accept invites.
4) Any required security docs beyond SOC2 + encryption-at-rest (we can share a short evidence packet).

Proposed timeline
- Provision sandbox workspace & test API keys: 2 business days after we get owners + IPs/SSO admin
- Ingest sample dataset + run smoke: 3-4 business days
- Evaluation + quality check: 7-10 business days

I've attached a draft success criteria spreadsheet to make it easier to align. Happy to hop on a 30m kickoff once you've confirmed owners and preferred access method.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: ACME-POC-success-criteria.xlsx

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below and a few clarifying Qs.

POC owners / stakeholders
- Primary: Alex Chen (Product) — alex.chen@acme.com (I'll be the day-to-day)
- Infra/Platform: Sofia Ramirez — sofia.ramirez@acme.com (will handle networking / allowlist)
- Data science reviewer: Kevin Park (cc not included here, will add later)

Access preference
- We'd prefer SSO for user access (Okta). For initial automated tests we will make calls from a small test runner hosted in our US region; I'll ask Sofia for the public IPs.

Questions
1) Can you provide a time-limited test API key for the sandbox while we set up SSO?
2) Any specific request headers or certificate pinning we should be aware of for the integration?

We are aiming for a 2-week POC starting the week of Mar 1 if provisioning can be completed this week.

Appreciate it — I'll get the IPs from Sofia and loop Kevin in on the quality criteria doc.

— Alex

2) Alex — can you confirm Tue Mar 9 or Wed Mar 10 for the 30m kickoff? Our recommended agenda: intro + roles, brief infra checklist, sample dataset handoff, run smoke tests, align on evaluation cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.
